### New
- **Clickable Color Themes preview**: hovering an item in the preview (wire, pin, label, sheet symbol; on PCB: track, pad, silkscreen…) highlights it and shows its name; clicking shows its row in the list and opens the color picker for it.
- **Complete schematic preview**: every color in the list now appears on an item in the preview (added a resistor, +5V / GND power symbols, sheet pin arrows, a note frame and a net class flag).
- **New editable schematic colors** (as in Altium): global label (port) fill, hierarchical label (harness) fill, **sheet pin fill** (the yellow area in Altium), note / text frame fill, directives and blankets. When not set they follow their previous colors — existing themes look the same; ↺ resets them to automatic.
